sources.what: Fithian, W. & Hastie, T. (2013). Finite-sample equivalence in statistical models for presence-only data. Annals of Applied Statistics 7(4): 1917-1939.

logistic regression. Cited in the lane brief.

integrity_statement: Every input byte is verified against the sha256 recorded in
registry/data_manifest.json. The competition bytes are owner-supplied
public GitHub mirrors; a matching digest proves transport identity, not
organizer-authenticated origin. No DrivenData credential is used and
drivendata.org is never contacted for data.
